verdict.rationale: Brave publishes a first-party API reference with per-endpoint pages (suggestions, spell check, rich search, local POIs, POI descriptions) and copy-pasteable curl examples. That gives a structured reference with runnable request snippets. Nothing shows an interactive in-browser 'try it' console, and the OpenAPI probe found no public spec (all candidate paths returned 404). missing for 10: interactive in-browser request execution/playground, public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
